subtitle: How the marks look over the cards.
calibrationHint: If marks look misplaced on your screen, adjust and test them.
voiceHint: Says out loud which card to pick, for when you are mid-fight.

plate.name: Plate
plate.description: A plate under each card; the best one gets a red frame.

badge.name: Badge
badge.description: A tier letter diamond on the corner.

ribbon.name: Ribbon
ribbon.description: A colored ribbon inside the card.

podium.name: Podium
podium.description: Ranks 1-2-3 in red, white and gray.

focus.name: Focus
focus.description: Dims the cards you should not pick.
